name: sentry/cli
title: Sentry — CLI and source map upload

SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: For the CLI rather than the runtime, so it is separate from the DSN. Sentry says to use a different token per use case, so a compromised one can be revoked without disturbing the rest, and shows an organisation token only once.

SENTRY_ORG.description: Which organisation the upload belongs to. An identifier.
